svg.title: Zava Forward: a resident's retrofit journey
svg.desc: Desk-research hypothesis; direct resident validation pending. Five resident moments; three rows: actions and needs, pain hypotheses, proposed gains. Human roles are proposed. Human roles are proposed responsibilities, not verified postholder appointments. Gains are proposed responses, not delivered resident benefits. Independent QA, assisted routes, works choice and the separate human safety route remain mandatory design boundaries. Read text-equivalent.md for full stage descriptions, source provisions, decision tests and presentation notes.
